items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: I remember Red on the base. I don't know what become here. Who's Big Red? I always call him Big Red.

ctx.x: You know myself who was John's band? I don't forget them all. I'm trying to remember.
I remember Red on the base. I don't know what become here. Who's Big Red? I always call him Big Red. I don't know. I always call him Red. All I know is the big red skin.
